Products built by Kobi Barak:
- AutoConnect (SaaS, live 2026): https://autoconnect.to — every lead from a website, Facebook, TikTok or calendar reaches the business WhatsApp within seconds and is saved to email, spreadsheet and CRM. 47 ready-made automations, 7 CRMs in one click, no code.

- Ale Zahav members & classes system (live since 2026): https://app.ale-zahav.co.il — full management system for a senior-clubs nonprofit: registration, class catalog, recurring credit-card billing, receipts, automated WhatsApp, attendance, reports and accounting export.
